tests.name: spawned CLI supports Markdown CRUD, conflicts, history, restore and sessions
spawned MCP honors host actor, scope ACL, schemas and stable permission errors
MCP HTTP transport is opt-in, authenticated, origin-checked, and serves the same tool API as stdio
two scoped remote agents passively deliver lifecycle observations to one authorized memory store
MCP transport selection rejects ambiguous modes and HTTP refuses a missing bearer secret
lifecycle adapter captures only explicit allowlisted events and redacts supplied text
remote lifecycle hook adapters install against one shared server and can be removed cleanly
remote capture spool redacts before persistence and retries delivery without storing credentials
unauthorized objects, scope lists, histories and journal metadata are non-disclosing
collections narrow workspace privileges and global sharing requires explicit grants
promotion produces sanitized derivative and hides protected origin from shared readers
malicious content has no authority and protected source snapshots remain unchanged
forged reference URIs do not validate through unrelated accessible object IDs
workspace IDs differing only by case cannot alias one directory (case-insensitive filesystems)
forbidden and nonexistent objects are indistinguishable across every read/write entry point
backlinks, related-graph traversal and context never reveal private nodes, edges, counts or titles
frontmatter/YAML injection through title, tags and metadata cannot forge status, kind, scope or visibility
path traversal, encoded separators, NUL bytes and hostile identifiers are rejected without touching the filesystem
forged worker payloads cannot make a job read or send inaccessible content to a model
secrets are redacted in stored observations, error messages and journal records
purge removes plaintext from derived SQLite indexes and WAL files, not only from canonical files
credential rotation atomically revokes the old bearer, preserves identity, narrows scopes, and audits without secrets
credential identities remain distinct under simultaneous provisioning and unauthorized audit reads disclose nothing
credential revocation is immediate and writes a secret-free administrative audit event
supported TLS reverse-proxy example terminates HTTPS in front of loopback-only MCP

gaps.item: Real prompt-injection resistance of a live model
gaps.reason: Deterministic tests prove injected text has no authority in the runtime (validated proposals, review gate, scope checks). Behaviour of a real model under injection is a model-eval item.

gaps.item: Case-insensitive filesystem path collisions beyond workspace/collection IDs
gaps.reason: IDs are folded and rejected; object IDs are generated lowercase.
Application-level ACLs and immutability do not defend against a user with direct filesystem access.

limitations: Zero-disclosure gate covers get/history/diff/patch/delete/restore/promote/links/backlinks/related, search counts and cursors, generated index files, forged queue payloads, traversal and YAML injection in the tested configurations.
